name: Iuno

tierList.prydwen: DPS: T0.5 Tower of Adversity, T4 Whimpering Wastes; Hybrid: T1 Tower of Adversity, T1.5 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Aero Gauntlets jack-of-all-trades: healing, shielding, DMG Amplification (Blessing of the Wan Light, up to 10 stacks of 4%), Heavy Attack buffing on Outro, and a viable Main DPS mode via her Lunar Cycle (Half Moon / New Moon) Forte stances, spending the 'Sentience' resource.

skills.normalAttack: Moonring Basic Attack (Half Moon) / Moonbow Basic Attack (New Moon, Liberation DMG, consumes Sentience for higher DMG + healing).
skills.resonanceSkill: Pulse of Origins baseline; Closing Refrain (after Intro) activates Lunar Cycle; Arc Beyond the Edge in New Moon (2 charges, Liberation DMG).
skills.forte: Ebb and Flow - governs Lunar Cycle Half Moon/New Moon toggling via Heavy Attack - Flux, and Sentience (max 100) spend/regen.
skills.liberation: Beneath Lunar Tides - Aero hit, activates Lunar Cycle, castable mid-air.
skills.intro: Illuminated Manifestation - Aero strike, restores 40 Sentience.
skills.outro: From Gloom to Gleam - Aero hit + 50% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification to next character for 14s.

bestWeapons: Stonard / Celestial Spiral / Hollow Mirage / Legend of Drunken Hero (craftable F2P options)
echoSet: Crown of Valor (Main DPS Iuno - only set she and Augusta fully stack: +30% ATK / +20% CRIT DMG)
Moonlit Clouds (Sub DPS/Hybrid Iuno - 10% Energy Regen + 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)

teams.name: Best Team (Hybrid)
teams.notes: Iuno buffs Augusta with up to 90% total DMG Amplification via Full Moon Domain.

teams.name: Main DPS Iuno
teams.notes: Lynae is generally best buffer (40% DMG Amplification via Outro); Ciaccona brings Aero RES Shred + fast rotation.

rotation: Sub DPS: Intro -> Ultimate -> Flux: Moonbow -> Enhanced Moonbow Basic 1-3 -> Arc Beyond the Edge x2 -> Forte Heavy: Absolute Fullness (swap) -> Outro. Main DPS extends with Closing Refrain and a second Moonbow Basic string before swap-cancelling the final Basic 3.
communityNotes: Prydwen: extremely flexible jack-of-all-trades - main DPS, sub DPS, buffer, healer, stamina support - but gives up her self-buffs on swap (quickswap-unfriendly) and the characters she buffs (Augusta, Jiyan) function fine without her via cheaper Mortefi. Still a top-tier single pull thanks to her strong solo Main DPS ceiling.
